Trevino Studios

$650 session

Houston wedding photographer covering Houston, Pearland, Galveston, and other Texas weddings. Named wedding collections list hours and image counts without dollar amounts; sessions and albums are priced.

Engagement and bridal sessions are each $650 for 1.5 hours and 50-plus edited images. Albums from 8x8 through 12x12 are $1,250–$5,000. A $400 per hour rate is also listed. The Basic, Classic, Premiere, and Luxe wedding collections do not show dollar amounts. Travel and tax are extra. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
